labctl.notes: x11 runtime (es40 AlphaServer ES40 emulator, headless SDL dummy + shm capture) — SRM-boots the disk directly, no ARC autoboot. No QMP; input = streamhost mamesock -> es40 ctlsock mamectl/1 unix socket ctl.sock. es40 binary is multi-client ctlsock (operator tools can inject input beside the attached daemon). Serial pair 21974/21975 is this tile's claim; ser1 doubles as the EXEC channel — exec_kind serialcon_e: the guest runs a getty on /dev/tty01 and the tile's pumps.py lends that line one client at a time over serial-exec.sock in the tile dir, so `labctl exec tru64 <cmd>` returns captured stdout and the guest's exit code with no network device in the machine. Pointer is ABSOLUTE and pixel-exact: the launcher sets ES40_POINTER_GAIN=2 because this guest moves 2 px per injected PS/2 count (odd targets land 1 px short), and the checkpoint carries X acceleration 1/1 threshold 0. Screen is 1280x1024 via -screen on the X server line in /etc/dt/config/Xservers. reset = relaunch restoring the CHECKPOINT: the launcher reflink-copies assets/tru64/checkpoint/tru64.img and restores checkpoint/tru64.axp (ES40_RESTORE), CDE desktop ~3 s after exec instead of the ~7-10 min cold boot; rollback = delete assets/tru64/checkpoint/ and it cold-boots img/tru64-seed.img.

museum.periodBrowser: Netscape Navigator 4.76 (graphical, at TrueColor; Lynx 2.8.9 also built in as a text fallback)
museum.blurb: DEC’s own UNIX on DEC’s own 64-bit iron. Born OSF/1 in 1992, renamed Digital UNIX and finally Tru64, this was the operating system the AlphaServer ES40 was designed around: a fully 64-bit UNIX with the CDE desktop, from the same company that built the processor under it. Version 5.1B of 2003 was the line’s last major release — HP retired Alpha and Tru64 together, and their engineering went on into HP-UX and beyond.
museum.notes: Live streamhost station — an x11-runtime station (irix/MAME was the first of that kind): the es40 AlphaServer ES40 emulator runs headless, captured via SH_CAPTURE=shm, input over the multi-client mamectl/1 ctlsock. SRM boot path, no ARC/AlphaBIOS autoboot (flash.rom boots the disk directly). The 5.1B install (115 subsets, AdvFS) was performed live on the station 2026-08-11/12; LISTED 2026-08-16. Scene (since 2026-08-17): a bare CDE desktop at 1280x1024 autologged-in as the UNPRIVILEGED user guest (uid 300) — the operator's seat — with Netscape Navigator 4.76 a click away on the Front Panel, browsing the OFFLINE retronet corpus over the guest's own TCP/IP stack (dec21143 at pci0.4 via pcap on the veth tru64-h/g, DHCP-reserved 10.99.0.15/24 on vmbr-rn, no default route, no WAN). Non-root login was gated by the missing OSF-BASE PAK; that is now RESOLVED — an OSF-BASE licence is registered in /var/adm/lmf/ldb (see docs/guests/tru64.md), so the machine is genuinely licensed and lmf list shows OSF-BASE active. Reset restores that whole scene in ~3 s. Pointer absolute and pixel-exact (ES40_POINTER_GAIN=2); labctl exec tru64 runs captured commands over a getty on the emulated com2 (serialcon_e). See docs/guests/tru64.md.

network.note: dec21143 at pci0.4 via pcap on the veth tru64-h/tru64-g; tru64-h enslaved to the OFFLINE retronet bridge vmbr-rn (rn-tapnet.sh), guest on DHCP -- the reserved 10.99.0.15/24 (rcmgr IFCONFIG_0=DYNAMIC) with NO default route behind the fail-closed TRU64RN-IN guard chain — reaches only the gateway CT 10.99.0.2 for its Gaim/OSCAR ICQ client (UIN 64000), never the LAN/gallery/internet. Rehomed 2026-08-21 from the pre-retronet outbound-NAT internet path (docs/lab/retronet/ICQ-STATION-tru64.md)

reset.fixture: Tru64 UNIX 5.1B, CDE desktop with dtlogin autologin as the UNPRIVILEGED user guest (Dtlogin*autoLogin: guest, 2026-08-17), 1280x1024 (X -screen), in es40 (AlphaServer ES40, EV68); SH_CAPTURE=shm (headless SDL dummy, no X server) + mamesock ctlsock input. The baked scene is a bare guest CDE desktop; Netscape Navigator 4.76 is wired to the Front Panel (netscape.fp Personal-Apps control + Netscape.dt action + /usr/local/bin/webbrowser) and reaches the retronet corpus origin on the gateway CT 10.99.0.2:80 through the guest dec21143 (DHCP-reserved 10.99.0.15/24 on the veth, contained, no WAN). Non-root login is possible because an OSF-BASE licence is registered in /var/adm/lmf/ldb (the PAK wall was resolved 2026-08-17; /usr/sbin/lmf is pristine). resetMode=relaunch: every reset reflink-copies assets/tru64/checkpoint/tru64.img and restores the checkpoint/tru64.axp savestate baked from it (~3 s to that scene); with no checkpoint staged it cold-boots the (also licensed) img/tru64-seed.img (~7-10 min). Keyboard PASS = SRM console echo and CDE navigation over ctlsock, framebuffer-proven. Mouse PASS = MOVEA measured against the guest XQueryPointer (exact on even coordinates, 1 px short on odd) and MOVEA+DOWN1/UP1 pressing a CDE button, 2026-08-17.
